headline: Advance removal and depositing of early voted ballots; results will not be announced until polls close.
summary: The city will remove and/or deposit early voted ballots in advance on the listed days. No results will be announced until after the polls close on November 3rd.

NOTICE OF ADVANCE REMOVAL AND 
DEPOSITING OF EARLY VOTING BALLOTS  
 
In accordance with the 950 CMR 47.12 and under the provisions of section 7(k) of Chapter 115 of the Acts of 2020, 
the City of Malden will be opening and/or depositing early voted ballots at the Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant 
Street at the following sessions.    
Please note the start time for the below sessions is 9:00 AM each day and will only continue as needed until 
completion. 
• Sunday, October 25th, for advance removal and/or depositing 
• Monday, October 26th, for advance removal and/or depositing 
• Tuesday, October 27th, for advance removal and/or depositing 
• Wednesday, October 28th, for advance removal and/or depositing 
• Thursday, October 29th,  for advance depositing and/or depositing 
• Friday, October 30th,  for advance depositing and/or depositing 
 
No results shall be determined or announced until after the time the polls close on November 3rd.  At that time the 
results from the advance processed ballots will be added to the Election Day results and posted at 
www.cityofmalden.org. 
提前處理 和 提前投票 (Early Voting) 選票 
整理及點票通知  
 
根據馬薩諸塞州法規 950 CMR 47.12 和 2020 年法案, 第 115 章, 第 7(k) 節的規定，摩頓市將在以下地方
及時段, 進行開啟和/或提前投票選票的整理及點票： 摩頓市政廳，215 派臣街 (Pleasant Street )。    
 
請注意，事務處理開始時間為每天上午 九時，並根據需要繼續，直至完成為止。 
 
● (星期日) 10 月 25日， 提前處理和/或整理點票事務 
● (星期二) 10 月 26 日，提前處理和/或整理點票事務 
● (星期三) 10 月 27 日，提前處理和/或整理點票事務 
● (星期四) 10 月 28 日，提前處理和/或整理點票事務 
● (星期五) 10 月 29 日，提前處理和/或整理點票事務 
● (星期六) 10 月 30 日，提前處理和/或整理點票事務 
 
在 11 月 3 日投票結束之前，不會確定或公佈任何結果。 屆時，預先處理的選票結果， 將添加到選舉日
結果中，並公布在 www.cityofmalden.org 網址上。
